output.evaluation_note: The Hán-Việt connection between Japanese '畜生' (ちくしょう) and Vietnamese 'súc sinh' is direct and strong, reinforcing the semantic alignment as a strong insult or expletive ('son of a bitch', 'beast'). The English 'damn' in this context also covers this exclamatory/insulting sense. All three expressions share a similar vulgar/informal register and are natural in their respective languages.
